- **OpenRouter Audio Transcription & Whisper STT**: Instagram Reels and voice dictation now seamlessly work with an OpenRouter API key (`sk-or-...`) alongside OpenAI.
- **Provider Auto-Detection**: If only an OpenRouter key is configured, transcription requests are automatically routed to OpenRouter's `/api/v1/audio/transcriptions` endpoint with appropriate model mapping (e.g. `openai/whisper-1`).
- **Updated Settings & Notices**: Settings hints and warning notices now correctly reflect OpenAI or OpenRouter credential availability.
